notes.title: English Version still needs to be improved.
notes.content:
Hi All, after several weeks' hard work, at last we finally finished the translation. But unfortunately we found some new bugs have been added into the game after the script translated. Now we are focusing on fixing those bugs. 

Regarding the current English version, I have to say that it's my fault to let the incomplete version publish to the public. I'm very sorry for the inconvenience casued by that. Now We are keeping updating those files and improve its quality. We will verify the scripts one by one to avoid the bugs comes out again. It may takes one or two weeks to finish the job. Once finished, we'll sand a notification to inform that. 

Thank you for your understanding.ːODWCː

notes.title: English Version
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the English translation of Gods One Day World will be finished by tomorrow! We have been hard at work editing the scripts and they are almost done now. 

There may still be some small errors/typos in the script upon release, and we hope to work those out over the next week.

Thank you for all your patience!

notes.content:
